history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The Administration has drawn lessons from the lease renewal and renovation project of DC-2 and has developed a revised construction timeline, which was compressed and restructured using an overlapping phased approach to expedite the implementation of the project. The new timeline allows construction to proceed more efficiently while still producing the required floor availability in time for the staff moves.
history.board_assessment: Given that the project team has developed a revised construction timeline and the implementation of the DC-2 renovation project has been closely monitored, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
